transcriber_notes: Printed as a list: province (small capitals), city, then items with figures; flattened to one row per item with province and city repeated. Province names given in title case. Total block printed at the end on p. 788 is given as rows with Province 'TOTAL'.
Tungchow and Yenan (p. 786, top) follow Sian without a new province heading and are given under Shensi.

In much of the list the figures are set half a line to a line below or above their labels (esp. pp. 785 right column and 786 right column); figures were paired with labels by counting within each city block, where the number of figures equals the number of labels in every block except Changsha.
